sources.note: A third review found three faults that passed the 29-fault suite at d59c19c (review-before/). Isabelle now proves the exact set of operations offered in each mode (ADSController_offered_by_mode) and uses wf_rcstore tr st None as its state invariant, so the trace ends in the current state; the invariant proofs add nth_append. The CSP command view keeps all eight public channels visible in both directions. The faults are now I10, I11 and F7. One run passes all five baselines, detects all 32 faults and passes all six controls; both scenarios keep their outcomes. These faults were exposed by review; the total is not an independent estimate.
